source.provenance: Existing generated PNG artwork; no frame is represented as extracted from a native GIF.

units: prototype map units; x/y is the projected foot-ground point
phaseContract: Use phase index floor(activeMovementMs / 90) % 8. Turn changes direction without resetting the phase; idle holds the last actual movement direction. Duration is an experiment, not speed calibration.

renderContract.position: ctx.translate(actor.x, actor.y); ctx.scale(mirrorX ? -1 : 1, 1); ctx.drawImage(image, -footPivot.x * scale, -footPivot.y * scale, width * scale, height * scale);
renderContract.scale: Every image uses the recorded final scale (map units per source pixel). Do not apply groupScale a second time. Do not scale each frame to its own alpha bbox.
renderContract.mirrorPivot: Mirror the actor-local coordinate system around actor.x/actor.y, not the PNG center. No extra mirrored PNG files.
renderContract.bodyHeightReference: alpha > 16 is used only to measure a source group median once; pixels and alpha are never altered. Idle uses the single basis-image body extent.
renderContract.validation: All pivots and the 76-unit scale are provisional integration estimates. They must be checked in the actual browser; no foot-lock or animation acceptance is claimed.

walk.sourceGroupScalePolicy: 1.0 except ne indices 4..7 use 0.70 as one group

knownIssues.s: Static leg exchange readable; continuous playback, foot sliding and loop seam not accepted.
knownIssues.n: Static leg exchange readable; continuous playback, foot sliding and loop seam not accepted.
knownIssues.se: Complete double step remains inconclusive; contact-frame leg identity is obscured by clothing.
knownIssues.e: Complete original v1; 00-to-01 and 04-to-05 spacing change is abrupt. Rejected single-frame corrections are excluded.
knownIssues.ne: Old 00-03 + new 04-07; new 06 improves leg exchange but 04/05 near-arm swap failed. Later group uses uniform 0.70 scale. Batch proportions and 03/04,07/00 seams remain unaccepted.
knownIssues.all: Preserves source low-alpha noise and asymmetric clothing/light. Mirroring is authorized for this unarmed walk trial only. 90 ms/frame is uncalibrated to current player speed; appearance remains subject to user review.

gifCapabilityCheck.action: No repeated imagegen request; capability limitation applies to the exposed tool schema, not to product availability.
